description: Read and edit a PDF's title, author, subject and keywords metadata.

faqs.a: Yes — title, author, subject and keywords are written into the document's info dictionary, so other PDF readers and search tools will see them.
faqs.q: Will other PDF readers see my changes?

faqs.a: Fields left empty are cleared from the metadata. Only the four editable fields are touched; the document content is never altered.
faqs.q: What happens to fields I leave empty?

faqs.a: No. Your PDF is read and rewritten entirely in your browser with PDF-Lib; it is never uploaded.

howto: The current title, author, subject and keywords appear below ("not set" if empty).
Edit the fields you want to change.
Click "Save metadata" and download the updated PDF.
title: PDF Metadata Editor
